children: TransUnion Chief Financial Officer Todd Cello is resigning from his role at the end of the year.

The company disclosed Cello's exit in a Wednesday filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. It said his resignation was not related to any disagreement with the company over its operations, policies, or practices.
Cello agreed to provide transition services to the company through March 1, 2027, according to the filing.
TransUnion said it will conduct a comprehensive search for its next CFO. It expects to appoint an interim CFO if a permanent successor has not been named by the time Cello resigns.
